exposure: monovalent recombinant acellular pertussis (aP) vaccine during pregnancy
combined tetanus-diphtheria-acellular pertussis (TdaP) vaccine during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women vaccinated with either monovalent recombinant acellular pertussis (aP) vaccine, combined tetanus-diphtheria (TdaP) vaccine, or Td-vaccine only.
finding: Recombinant pertussis vaccination in the second or third trimester of pregnancy leads to high levels of passive pertussis immunity in infants, with no reported adverse pregnancy, delivery, or neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: Vaccination performed at <27 or 27-36 weeks gestation
